greeting: Dear HPE SASE & Security Hiring Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Networking & Cybersecurity Intern role with HPE Networking's SASE & Security organization in San Jose. My B.S. in Computer Science from UC Irvine specialized in Networked Systems, and secure networking, Zero Trust and identity are exactly where I want to build depth. I spend summers in Dublin, CA, so San Jose is an easy commute for a Summer 2027 internship.

Most of my hands-on security work is on CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app I built and still operate on the App Store, backed by Google Cloud. I own its identity and access management end to end: Sign in with Apple with a nonce and SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and email/password with server-enforced verification, plus Firebase App Check (App Attest) on every backend request. I wrote role-based access-control rules that block IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and 36 adversarial unit tests try to break them. Server-side Cloud Functions enforce authentication, input validation and rate limiting.

My coursework covered computer networks, operating systems, and security and privacy, including RSA, elliptic-curve cryptography and TLS. In labs I used Wireshark and Burp Suite to study MITM, ARP poisoning, DNS spoofing, SQL injection and XSS. I script in Python and Node.js and use Git daily. I'm also studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I'm used to clear communication, taking feedback and managing my time.
I'd welcome the chance to help build, test and document SASE and Zero Trust solutions with your team this summer. I'm available for Summer 2027.
